name: 8-Week Pilates Program

included.title: Initial Online Assessment (75 minutes)
included.detail: We'll meet live via Zoom to assess your movement, discuss your background, understand your needs, and establish clear goals for the next eight weeks.

included.title: 7 Private Online Sessions (60 minutes each)
included.detail: One-on-one coaching with me, once a week. Each session is individually designed around your needs and progress, with exercises adjusted as you develop strength, mobility, and control.

included.title: Personalized Weekly Plan
included.detail: After each session, you'll receive a simple, written plan of what to practice during the week so you can stay consistent between sessions.

included.title: Session Recordings
included.detail: Every Zoom session is recorded, and you'll receive a copy to revisit the exercises, instructions, and cues whenever you need.

included.title: Weekly Check-In
included.detail: A personal check-in via WhatsApp or text to see how you're feeling, follow your progress, and answer any questions that come up throughout the week.

faq.q: Is this medical care or physical therapy?
faq.a: No. Pilates is exercise. I don't diagnose or treat anything. I plan careful, injury-aware sessions and I'm happy to work alongside the advice of your doctor or physical therapist.

faq.q: Do I need to be cleared for exercise?
faq.a: Yes. If you have an injury, a recent surgery or a medical condition, please get the OK from your doctor or PT before we start. If you are not sure, ask them first.

faq.q: I've never done Pilates. Is that OK?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is taught step by step and adapted to you.

disclaimer: Pilates is exercise, not medical care. This program does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition. Please check with your doctor or physical therapist before starting any exercise program, and stop any movement that causes sharp or unusual pain.
